paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
suggested_experiment_name: JEDI (COSY storage ring, polarized deuteron beam)
coupling_convention: |d_AC^d|, amplitude of the oscillating deuteron EDM in e*cm (plot y-axis is |d_AC^d| in units of 1e-23 e*cm; emitted values include this multiplier)
notes: First storage-ring search for ALP dark matter using a polarized deuteron beam at COSY (JEDI collaboration). No resonance observed; 90% CL upper limit |d_d_AC| < 6.4e-23 e*cm quoted as the average over the scanned range, valid over the narrow frequency window 120.0-121.4 kHz corresponding to ALP mass 0.495-0.502 neV (4.95e-10 to 5.02e-10 eV), encoded as a flat two-point bound. Note this constrains the DEUTERON (not neutron) oscillating EDM; the paper also derives bounds on g_adgamma, ALP-gluon coupling C_G^d/f_a, and axion-wind coupling C_d/f_a, but the primary quoted numerical result is the oscillating EDM. The experiment assumes ALPs constitute the local galactic dark matter (density value not explicitly stated in the provided text, so left null).
